Question 2

Which of the following is equivalent to f(x)=x+x2+x3?

a
 f:x+x2↦x3
b
 f:x↦x2+x3
c
 f:x↦x+x2+x3
d
 f:x2↦x+x3
e
 f:x3↦x+x2
